answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade, and let that bond turn into reputation only through verified completed work: a single identity must first bridge small escrowed jobs, building a history that cannot be bought instantly, while a newcomer sits on a low knoll of trust with tight rate limits. A whisper network of peers then cross-checks that work before the bond unlocks. Creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand bonds and paying for a thousand slow histories, so a Sybil flood costs real capital and time while earning almost nothing.
